---
title: "Run health"
subtitle: "Did Google answer? One row per scheduled run."
toc: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/dashboard_helpers.R")
run_log <- read_data("run_log")
```

Google Trends sometimes refuses automated requests with HTTP 429 ("too many requests"). A run where most searches show `rate_limited` was blocked; the next run usually works. If this happens for several runs in a row, increase the pauses in `run_radar.R` or remove seeds from `seeds.txt`.

## Recent runs

```{r}
if (is.null(run_log)) {
  note("No runs yet.")
} else {
  run_log |>
    group_by(run_id) |>
    summarise(
      `Chile time` = first(run_time_chile),
      Answered = sum(status %in% c("ok", "empty")),
      `With rising queries` = sum(status == "ok"),
      `Rate limited` = sum(status == "rate_limited"),
      Errors = sum(status %in% c("error", "skipped")),
      `Rising queries` = sum(as.integer(n_rising), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(run_id)) |>
    rename(`Run (UTC)` = run_id) |>
    dt_table(page_length = 20)
}
```

## Latest run, search by search

```{r}
if (!is.null(run_log)) {
  run_log |>
    filter(run_id == max(run_id)) |>
    arrange(match(window, WINDOW_ORDER), seed) |>
    transmute(Seed = seed, Window = window, Status = status,
              HTTP = http, `Rising queries` = n_rising, Note = htmlEscape(note)) |>
    dt_table(page_length = 30)
}
```
